size: full -- 5 check(s) against their platform moved

gaps.claim: Deep investigation replies carry metadata.auto=true, kind=deep; the check counts them as the automatic first pass. A2A-0017/0018/0019 got kind=deep replies in 4.5/2/6 min yet PRE-0191 failed them; #132 reads STILL REPRODUCIBLE on a fixed lane.
'paid' counted as fixed: #130 and #132 went straight to paid and still reproduce, yet the 7:00 report lists them under 'Opravili'.
A status without last_attempt is read as not stuck (pass) while the docstring says a missing field is INCONCLUSIVE; the PASS on #133 rests on this check.
The docstring names 'no visible health state' (page reads LIVE) as part of the defect; the assertion never reads the page, so #133 verified fixed while their own notes say the page line is not done.
Fixed count reads the first number of the first bullet: '#133 ...' -> 133, 'Nic.' -> 1.
Sweeps counted from tick decisions containing 'hunt', not from sweeps that ran: a skipped hunt counts, the operator's /qa-sweep does not.
Nexus line subtracts verdicts of all his rooms (bots/funds never pass the card gate) from card gate passes and counts stopped-inconclusive rooms as still running.

The 'later run, same definition' case (:1236) folds with result()'s default FP1 while the row is pinned to FP, so it reads CHECK_CHANGED and verification_owed is [] whether or not a verification was sent; the regression it names would stay green.

Docstring (:123) says reverting serve.py to fetch_our_reports would fail here; the test calls bounty.refresh_our_reports directly and serve.py's _poll_tracker swallows exceptions (:437-449), so that revert stays green.
If brief()'s heading 'his proposals, best earner first' is renamed, partition leaves his_block empty (:3674-3676) and 'OUR-0001 not in his_block' passes with nothing checked (C05 shape).

Stub paper.close returns {} (:1703) so the code records close_failed; the test asserts only the attempt (:1728), green while its own fixture says the sale was refused; 'money comes back' is never measured.
The walk covers scripts/lab.py and scripts siblings only (:1609-1651), never qa/, which the night calls constantly; a git commit added under qa/ would pass (latent).
'Short' has no bound (:194-218): the page can grow without limit and stay green (cosmetic). B04, the sweeps-count label, is R06.

A reply with no metadata.auto key is recorded auto=None (:109) and counted as an investigation (:68), so first passes without the flag would pass the check (is_answer shape). A01, the gem-screener missing last_attempt/ok, is R03; the auditor confirmed today's #133 PASS read ok:true.

LIVE_INVEST (:55) matches only it's with an ASCII apostrophe; html.unescape (:62) turns ’ into a typographic one that never matches, so a live profile reads as 'offer gone' and the check passes (the 2026-09-07 apostrophe incident).
Only digit response keys are read (:60); a 404 declared by '4XX' or 'default' still reads as undeclared (:71), a false claim to the vendor if they fix it that way.

A paper buy whose POST times out (or 2xx without position id) is recorded unknown; the room is stopped as 'nothing at stake', _deployed/book()/_room_positions skip it and paper.jsonl has no reconcile, so a buy that landed rides unsold, unjudged and outside both brakes.
book() subtracts money moved into bots plus their total_profit_usdc from cash, so a bot's loss reads as spendable cash (fund 1000, profit -200 -> cash 99200 not 99000) and equity never shows bot P&L.

Any my-clones row without an accepted fund of ours makes capital_in_bots None and every later paper.buy exits (:495); a clone accepted but not funded (lab.py:2411-2418) then blocks every card room, each opened and burned.

_guidance reads only nexus.jsonl, while rooms.nexus_answers and clone._guidance read both diaries; a card pick from a nexus_shallow answer opens a room, then paper.buy refuses 'not a recorded Nexus answer' and the pick is burned.

A non-dict get_fund_history answer becomes {} and _fund_points [], so a failed read is an empty history: launch_fund writes no_series, never retries, and the fund room is inconclusive for good (rule 8 shape).
A stop bot_stops classifies 'unexplained' with a positive result is labelled 'take-profit' on /lab, a cause our data does not record.
